user.title: Set up Visonic Alarm
user.description: Connect Home Assistant to your Visonic alarm system using the same server and account details used by Visonic Go or ConnectAlarm.

data_description.host: PowerManage server address, for example visonic.tycomonitor.com.
data_description.app_id: Application UUID used when connecting to the Visonic service.
data_description.user_email: Email address used with Visonic Go or ConnectAlarm.
data_description.user_password: Password for the Visonic Go or ConnectAlarm account.
data_description.panel_id: Alarm panel ID registered to the account.
data_description.partition: Alarm partition. Existing installations commonly use -1 for all partitions.
data_description.name: Name shown for this alarm system in Home Assistant.
data_description.no_pin_required: Allow Home Assistant alarm commands without entering a PIN.
data_description.event_hour_offset: Optional hour adjustment applied to alarm event timestamps.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Visonic alarm service.

abort.already_configured: This Visonic alarm is already configured.
